Exactly one unbranded dark-green step-through city bicycle with a black saddle, silver handlebar and two consistent wheels. Its front points toward the exit. Establish a relationship through restrained waiting and a clear acknowledging look, without sadness or grateful overacting.

Both remain in place; the mechanic glances back toward the saddle, preparing to attend to it.
The bicycle stands between them without blocking their sightline. The mechanic maintains contact with the stem; the commuter has not taken the bicycle yet.
Locked oblique medium-wide two-shot, without camera movement or zoom.
Keep both upper bodies, exchanged looks and both grounded wheels readable; the exit remains screen right.
Natural overcast light after rain, readable skin and interior shadows, without expressive light beams.
Establish waiting over two seconds, exchange the look around seconds two to three, then allow time to read both people.
Only natural street/cloth/contact sound, no speech, narration or music. No generated text, logo, title, fade or cuts inside the clip.
Restrained realism at normal speed.
